Priya: starting a short capture thread for customer wins/losses mentioned in today's all-hands Q&A. drop tiny notes (1-2 lines) + link to any ticket.

Marcus: Win — Kestrel Finance picked Dedicated. reason: predictable throughput & SLA. follow-up RED-4821. :tada:

Elena: Loss — BrightShelf POC failed during copy generation. hallucinations vs their baseline. CS ticket CS-733.

Gabe: Loss — demo blew up at long contexts (4k+). competitor had faster tail latency. ENG-1298 created to profile.

Ava: Win — VectorMetrics used hosted embeddings; integration speed was the sell. they asked for a batch-embedding SDK.

Marcus: recurring loss theme: procurement confusion over per-token vs reserved pricing. ask for clear TCO examples.

Priya: please paste short entries using this tiny template so I can collate:
- customer: <org>
- vertical: <industry>
- outcome: won|lost|eval
- why: 1-line
- top_ask: 1-line
- followup_owner: @name (link)
